canvas_settings.image_style: clean modern high-fidelity web app UI mockup, flat design, sans-serif typography, light theme

layers.description: Solid light grey page backdrop filling the entire square canvas behind everything else.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Root background layer; the browser window floats centered on top of it.

layers.description: A desktop browser window with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, white content area, occupying most of the canvas; its chrome strip along the window top shows three small grey circular window buttons at the left and a wide rounded grey address bar holding the small grey web address "localhost:3000".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered above the background; the app card sits inside its white content area below the chrome strip.

layers.description: A centered white application card with a thin light border, rounded corners and a subtle shadow; it holds the whole todo app stacked top to bottom: header band, create row, error banner and list panel.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered horizontally in the browser content area below the chrome; owns the header, create row, error banner and list panel as its only children.

layers.description: Card header band with the app title "My Todos" in large dark sans-serif text aligned to the left with padding.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: First child inside the app card, directly under its top edge; title aligned to the card left padding.

layers.description: Create row with a single-line text input showing grey placeholder text "Add a new todo…", a blue filled button labeled "Add" immediately to the right of the input, and small grey helper text "Up to 500 characters" under the input.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the app card below the header; input and button share one horizontal line, helper text left-aligned under the input.

layers.description: Table-like list panel with a shared frame: one thin outer container with horizontal divider lines between rows; the list contains exactly 3 text-bearing rows and no empty bands, no rows without todo text, nothing below the third row. Each row is a horizontal band with a checkbox at the left, the todo text next to it, and buttons at the right. Row 1, done: checked blue checkbox with white tick, text "Buy milk" in faded grey crossed by a single thin strikethrough through the text middle, and one grey text-button "Delete" at the right with no Edit button. Row 2, done: checked blue checkbox with white tick, text "Pay electricity bill" in faded grey crossed by a single thin strikethrough through the text middle, and one grey text-button "Delete" at the right with no Edit button. Row 3, not-done, newest at the bottom: empty unchecked checkbox, text "Walk the dog" in solid dark with no strikethrough, and two grey text-buttons "Edit" and "Delete" at the right. Every visible "Edit" and "Delete" label sits inside one of these 3 enumerated rows.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the app card below the error banner, spanning the card inner width; the single owner of all list rows, dividers and row buttons.

layers.description: Stale-operation error banner: a light-red rounded rectangle strip inside the app card positioned above the list panel in the gap under the create row, containing one small line of dark-red text reading "Todo does not exist" left-aligned with padding; the banner is not a todo row, has no checkbox, no divider and no buttons, and this string is rendered exactly once in the whole image.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Owned by the app card, stacked between the create row and the list panel, spanning the card inner width; the list panel and its three rows sit entirely below it.
